# VS Store

> VS Store is a curated online marketplace for practical everyday essentials, future-ready tech and lifestyle accessories, with secure Shopify checkout and tracked fulfilment.

## Public storefront

- [Homepage](https://future-light-store.vercel.app/): What VS Store is and how it helps shoppers.
- [Shop all](https://future-light-store.vercel.app/shop): Search and filter the live product catalog.
- [Collections](https://future-light-store.vercel.app/collections): Browse collection hubs by shopping intent.
- [Help centre](https://future-light-store.vercel.app/help): Delivery, returns, payment and order-tracking answers.
- [Track order](https://future-light-store.vercel.app/track-order): Check fulfilment status using an order number and checkout email.
- [Account](https://future-light-store.vercel.app/account): Customer profile and Shopify account links.

## Featured shopping intents

- [Travel and outdoor essentials](https://future-light-store.vercel.app/collections/travel-outdoor)
- [Portable gadgets](https://future-light-store.vercel.app/collections/portable-gadgets)
- [Car accessories](https://future-light-store.vercel.app/collections/car-accessories)
- [Home safety](https://future-light-store.vercel.app/collections/home-safety)
